📋 How to deploy 100% Free Google Drive Storage Backend in 1 Minute (Click to expand)
  1. Open Google Drive (drive.google.com) or visit script.google.com and click New project.
  2. Delete any default code in Code.gs, copy the script below, and paste it.
  3. Click Deploy > New deployment > select type Web app.
  4. Set Execute as: Me and Who has access: Anyone.
  5. Click Deploy, grant permission with your Google account, and copy the Web App URL.
  6. Paste the URL into the Google Drive Storage Endpoint box above and click Save Storage Endpoints!
